10k.note: 10-K describes EsoCheck (FDA 510(k)-cleared device) and EsoGuard (laboratory developed test / NGS DNA assay run in Lucid's CLIA lab). No drug or biologic pipeline. R&D activity focused on reimbursement-supporting utility studies, not P1/P2/P3 drug trials.

website.note: Clinical-data page lists observational / real-world / validation studies (BETRNet, ESOGUARD BE-1, CLUE, Lucid Registry, VA, Firefighter Health Fair, Genetic Classifier). All are device-validation or reimbursement evidence studies — none are P1/P2/P3 therapeutic clinical trials. No NCT IDs listed on the company page.

ctgov.note: Zero P1-P3 trials on ClinicalTrials.gov sponsored by Lucid Diagnostics.

products.name: EsoCheck
products.type: Esophageal Cell Collection Device (swallowable balloon capsule catheter)
products.status: FDA 510(k)-cleared and CE Mark certified; commercially marketed

products.name: EsoGuard
products.type: Bisulfite-converted targeted NGS DNA methylation assay (VIM + CCNA1, 31 sites)
products.status: Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) performed in Lucid's CLIA-certified lab; commercially marketed
products.indication: Detection of Barrett's esophagus and esophageal adenocarcinoma in at-risk GERD patients

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage molecular diagnostics company. Sole focus is selling EsoGuard (LDT) and EsoCheck (FDA 510(k)-cleared device) for esophageal precancer screening. No proprietary drug, biologic, or device asset in P1/P2/P3 development. Ongoing studies (CLUE, Lucid Registry) are observational real-world evidence efforts to support payer reimbursement, not therapeutic clinical trials.
